integrity: Analytic proof plus standalone standard-library exact-rational checker; no independent review or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Connected finite simple graphs, two independent edge draws from one fixed law, exact arithmetic averaging and centered identity covariance. No asymptotic-rate or worst-initial-vector claim. The maximum-degree-three support guarantee is universal, and a degree-four counterexample does not classify all higher-degree graphs. Unindexed equivalent finite-horizon gossip work remains possible.
title: A sharp degree-three full-support law for optimal two-contact randomized averaging
